{{Quote|The ''Tempest''? That's a ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer, isn't it?''"<br />"''Right. From Dulathia. Our guys got out right before the Rebels overtook the place. She delivered some equipment they managed to salvage for us.|[[Dair Haslip]] and [[Nilo (Imperial)|Nilo]]|<ref name="Mission to Zila">{{JournalCite|3|Mission to Zila}}</ref>}}
'''Dulathia''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], until it was retaken by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Tempest (Victory-class)|''Tempest'']] was one of the few ships to survive, and brought its contents to [[Garos IV]].
